title: Monotonic stack
objective: Find the next greater element for every item in one pass.

sources.title: Laaksonen, Competitive Programmer's Handbook: nearest smaller elements, using a stack

simplifies: This finds the next greater value to the right. "Previous", "smaller" and "or equal" versions just change the comparison or the direction.

options.explanation: Right. Nothing to the right of 5 is bigger; 4 is the first number bigger than 3; nothing follows 4.
The last item has nothing to its right, so it keeps -1.
That is just the next item. It must also be bigger: 3 is not bigger than 5.

quiz.prompt: Why is this one pass instead of O(n²)?

options.text: Each index is pushed once and popped at most once
options.explanation: Right. The inner while loop does at most n pops in total over the whole run.
It does run: every pop is the while loop resolving a waiting index.
It does not need sorted input.
